name: V3 Ferengi reward persistence and replay after server restart

tests.name: Resolve destroyed Ferengi ship identity and durable destruction sequence

data.sql: SELECT ship_id,destruction_sequence FROM ships WHERE name='V3 Ferengi QA warship';

tests.name: Authenticated player sees reward balance persisted
Destroyed NPC remains unavailable after restart
Reward sequence has exactly one system-generated event and no duplicate credit

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN s.destroyed AND r.destruction_sequence=@{destruction_sequence} AND r.amount=5000 AND r.source='system_generated' AND r.recipient_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='v3_bounty_hunter') AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ferengi_destruction_rewards WHERE ship_id=s.ship_id)=1 AND (SELECT credits FROM players WHERE name='v3_bounty_hunter')=6234 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM ships s JOIN ferengi_destruction_rewards r USING(ship_id,destruction_sequence) WHERE s.ship_id=@{ferengi_ship};
